releaseNotes: v1.0.1 — the Antigravity lane rebuilt from the shipped client. The 429 a Claude Code request used to hit was a filtering verdict, not quota: Google keys on the caller's identity sentence in the system prompt, so 'You are Claude Code.' was refused while the same account answered 200 for a neutral prompt seconds earlier with 61% of its weekly bucket left. The lane now sends the client's own identity block and request tags, rewrites that sentence, and the account is parked until its real weekly reset instead of being retried every two seconds. Six more wire divergences came out of a MITM capture of the shipped client (the model_enum mapping, the per-model output budget, the Claude budget dialect, the systemInstruction key, the numeric session id and the identity block), all verified live against Google's backend through the gateway's own HTTP API. Also in this release: an Automatic Backup panel in the dashboard, Cloudflare Workers AI content flattening and its free-window skip, and a dropped Docker Hub publish job. See docs/RELEASING.md.
